title: Gold and Silver ALERT: The Longer The Wait, The Greater The Risk
speaker: Jeffrey Christian

macro_themes.view: Expects October surprises and volatility; biggest gold impact after elections, contested results could push investors into gold/silver.
Real rates rising and bond markets stressed but not collapsing; authorities still have rope to paper over crises.
Cooling inflation expectations may be a false hope; sees strong inflationary pressures ahead.
Big Beautiful Bill cuts kick in late Q4/Q1 2027 and will hurt consumer spending, the economy and stocks.
Gold may see a cyclical peak within 2 years, followed by a cyclical decline within a secular bull market, as in 2011-2019.
Diesel deal/relaxed sanctions mean Russia needs to sell less gold and may buy at times.
